body.title: turn-lifecycle.ts: stop and detach
body.summary: Move stopLive, stopActive and detachActive into the module as stop() and detach(): abort the lease wait, return the iterator, cancel the provider turn and stop the live process (stop), or for a session-file turn stop reading and keep the process, lease and saved cursor (detach). A pipe turn is stopped either way. Add unit tests.
acceptanceChecks: stop cancels the provider turn, stops the live process, resolves once it has exited, and is idempotent with nothing running
stop or detach while a turn waits for its lease drops that turn silently
detach keeps a session-file turn running with its lease, saves its cursor and removes it from runningTurns; detach stops a pipe turn
failures from cancel or proc.stop are swallowed and the remaining steps still run
live is undefined after stop and after detach

tests.name: stop cancels the provider turn and stops the live process; idempotent with nothing running
stop and detach drop a turn waiting for its lease
detach leaves a session-file turn running with its cursor saved and stops a pipe turn
stop continues past a failing cancel or process stop
